implemented_capabilities.capability: Source-backed fact validation (freshness, verification, supersession, conflict, fact-hash drift)
implemented_capabilities.notes: A fact counts only if its Source is verified, not dated after as_of, within a freshness window (30d default) and not superseded. Source.fact_hash is compared with a SHA-256 recomputed from the live node fields, so an edit that bypasses source versioning yields SOURCE_MISMATCH; equally recent disagreeing sources yield CONFLICTING_SOURCES. Pure Python, deterministic.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Deterministic multi-check eligibility engine with evidence paths
implemented_capabilities.notes: Per-candidate checks return pass/fail/unknown/not_applicable with reason codes and source IDs; missing dates or audits resolve to unknown (never silently pass). Status precedence ineligible > unknown > excluded_by_memory > eligible. Builds EvidencePath objects (nodes/edges with source_ids) from graph rows only. Domain is creator-replacement for marketing campaigns but the pattern is domain-generic.

All decision-affecting writes run under one asyncio lock; same Idempotency-Key + payload replays, same key different payload raises IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Each write is ONE Cypher statement that matches Workspace.context_revision = $expected_revision, writes a MutationReceipt and bumps the revision; no returned row means conflict.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Human approval gating with full revalidation and immutable snapshot
implemented_capabilities.notes: Agent can only stage a DRAFT for a candidate eligible in the current evaluation; approval is a separate HTTP action that rechecks slot, run status, revision and re-runs consistent_evaluate before Q10 creates an approval Decision linked to the Proposal, Session and supporting Sources. Proposal snapshot_json (candidate, evidence paths, source excerpts, as_of, context_revision) is immutable; draft goes stale if revision moves.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Scoped rejection memory with expiry and append-only revocation (decision lineage)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Decisions carry scope (campaign|brand), as_of, optional expires_at (exclusive); revocation is a new Decision node with REVOKES edge; original is never deleted. Each decision also creates an operator_feedback Source node so the rationale is itself evidence.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Versioned source edits via SUPERSEDES chain
implemented_capabilities.notes: A fact edit atomically updates the node, creates a new Source (new version, new fact_hash) with (new)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old), moves current SUPPORTED_BY, refreshes the audit source and bumps revision. Old sources retained. Demo-edit surface to show drift being detected.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Bounded local-LLM tool agent (Ollama) with server-side guardrails
implemented_capabilities.notes: Five allowlisted tools (get_campaign_requirements, evaluate_candidates, get_candidate_evidence, get_previous_decisions, stage_replacement_proposal); server injects run/campaign/as_of/revision; model output is validated against the deterministic evaluation and has one repair attempt. The LLM only orchestrates and summarizes; all decisions are in rules.py. Requires a local Ollama model.

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph 'campaign_context_*'. Labels: Workspace(context_revision, seed_status), Brand, Creator, Campaign, Offer, Availability, Agreement, Audit, Source(version, observed_at_ms, verified, checksum, fact_hash, kind), Session, Run, Proposal(status, snapshot_json, context_revision), Decision(action approved|rejected|revoked, scope_type, scope_id, as_of_ms, expires_at_ms), MutationReceipt. Edges: HAS_BRAND, RUNS, HAS_CREATOR, HAS_AVAILABILITY, HAS_AGREEMENT, HAS_AUDIT, WITH_BRAND, COMPETES_WITH, PARTICIPATED_IN, OFFERS, SUPPORTED_BY, SUPERSEDES, HAS_RUN, FROM_RUN, FOR_CAMPAIGN, SELECTS, CONSIDERED, APPROVES, REVOKES, IN_SESSION, HAS_RECEIPT. 50+ named parameterized .cypher templates (Q00..Q13, SEED_*) loaded by db/queries.py; reads go through GRAPH.RO_QUERY. Single-statement MATCH..WHERE revision CAS + CREATE + SET patterns with FOREACH; OPTIONAL MATCH receipt for idempotency. No APOC/GDS; plain openCypher that FalkorDB supports. Only values are bound parameters; no string-concatenated Cypher.
algorithms: Evidence support resolution: pick latest valid source, detect CONFLICTING_SOURCES by differing fact_hash among equally recent sources, SOURCE_MISMATCH vs recomputed node hash (services/evidence.py:fact_support)
Tri-state interval overlap that returns unknown when a missing end date could matter (services/rules.py:overlap_tristate)
Status precedence ineligible > unknown > excluded_by_memory > eligible and ranking by (fee asc, completed campaigns desc, creator id) (services/rules.py:evaluate_context, status_of)
Decision activeness: made-at <= as_of, exclusive expiry, effective revocation (services/memory.py:decision_is_active)
Optimistic concurrency via workspace revision CAS inside a single Cypher statement + idempotency receipts (services/mutations.py, queries/Q10_approve.cypher)
backend_interfaces: CLI: python -m app.cli (seed, reset-demo, preflight, verify-model)
frontend_interfaces: React/Vite/TS: App.tsx, CampaignCard, CandidateTable, Conversation, EvidenceDrawer, PathDiagram, SourceViewer, ProposalDialog, RejectDialog, HistoryTab, DataEditorTab, Header, ErrorBoundary; generated OpenAPI types (src/api/schema.d.ts)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Bounded tool-calling loop (8 turns / 12 tool calls / 180 s) against a local Ollama model; final answer is JSON-schema constrained and cross-validated against the deterministic evaluation with one repair. Persistent operator memory is graph-native (Decision nodes with scope/expiry/revocation, Session/Run history, MutationReceipt idempotency). Prompt includes anti-injection instruction and verify.py contains an injection-style source-text fixture to test resistance; model reasoning text is deliberately not persisted.
tests_present: ~230 test functions: unit (test_rules 30, test_evidence 10, test_timeutil 9, test_dataset 9, test_config 9, test_ollama_adapter 7, others) and integration against live FalkorDB (test_oracle 26, test_approval 17, test_agent_loop 14, test_memory 13, test_read_api 11, test_sessions_runs 11, test_write_api 10, test_demo_edits 8, test_atomicity 2, etc.) with a fake model helper; frontend Vitest + Playwright specs; docs/verification has recorded live-model run reports. Integration tests need FalkorDB (compose.test.yaml).
security_findings: backend/app/config.py - settings validators force FalkorDB and Ollama endpoints to loopback and refuse cloud-tagged models (positive control, limits unrestricted network calls)

backend/app/security.py:25-52 - LoopbackHostMiddleware + write_guard (nonce, Origin allowlist, Idempotency-Key UUID); explicitly 'not multi-user authentication' so unsuitable as-is for a networked multi-tenant deployment
backend/app/agent/verify.py:~30 - embeds a prompt-injection style test string (INJECTION) used against the model in verification scenarios; it is test data only, not executed as an instruction
scripts/e2e_backend.py:22, scripts/persistence_check.py:38,44, scripts/make_demo_cut.py:29,56,70 - subprocess.run of python/docker/ffmpeg with list args (no shell=True); dev/demo scripts only
No eval/exec/pickle found in backend/app; all Cypher via named templates with bound params (no string concatenation); db/client.py:run_catalog_script splits index script on ';' (static files only)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps Agent Memory & Provenance (decision lineage, receipts), approval gating / human-in-the-loop, source-evidence validation and supersession. Domain (creator replacement) is unique but the evidence/approval engine is domain-generic and overlaps any 'agent proposes, human approves' repo.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - implements source freshness, supersession (SUPERSEDES chain), fact-hash drift detection (SOURCE_MISMATCH), revision-gated approvals with re-evaluation, expiry/revocation of decisions and immutable decision snapshots, all directly mappable to an Evidence Drift Cascade engine.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, pure-Python, deterministic evidence-validity and fact-hash drift logic plus a proven idempotent revision-CAS mutation pattern against FalkorDB 4.x via falkordb 1.8; directly reusable for Kairos approval gating and drift detection.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: none for evidence.py/factsig.py/memory.py; FalkorDB for Cypher mutation templates; Ollama only for the optional agent loop

strategy_rationale: evidence.py, factsig.py, memory.py and the revision-CAS/receipt mutation pattern are domain-agnostic and portable into a shared Kairos evidence/approval layer; the creator-eligibility rules and Ollama agent are domain-specific and should stay as reference or an optional capability pack.
